content: Rhetorical Structure Theory (RST) BIBREF0 is a technique of Natural Language Processing (NLP), in which a document can be structured hierarchically according to its discourse. The generated hierarchy, a tree, provides information associated with the boundaries of the discourse segments and related to their importance and dependencies. The figure FIGREF1 shows an example of such a rethorical tree. In the rethorical parsing process, the text has been divided into five units. In the figure FIGREF1, the arrow that leaves the unit (2) towards the unit (1) symbolizes that the unit (2) is the satellite of the unit (1), which is the core in a “Concession” relationship. In turn, the units (1) and (2) comprise the nucleus of three “Demonstration” relationships.
